column3: God bless each and every one of you.
God bless you and your family.
God bless - I must go for good at this point.
God speed to those who will be put in harms way.
God bless the United States of America.
May God also grant all of us the wisdom to ask what concrete steps we can take to reduce the violence and weaponry in our midst.
Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
God bless each and every Patriot in the world.
GOD BLESS YOU AND GOD BLESS THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.
God bless our brave men & women in uniform.
God bless our brave fighting men & women.
God Bless the United States of America.
GOD BLESS PATRIOTS AROUND THE WORLD.
GOD BLESS THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.
